meta.source: Limelight Brand Guidelines.pdf + [Handoff] Limelight.fig + live marketing site limelight-test.webflow.io (Webflow variables and classes)

tokens.name: limelight-black
tokens.usage: Brand black (guide 2.1 Neutrals). The logo and symbol ink on light grounds; the ground for the white logo.

tokens.name: limelight-white
tokens.usage: Brand white (guide 2.1 Neutrals). Logo ink on limelight-black; label on the primary Button.

tokens.name: limelight-off-white
tokens.usage: Brand off-white (guide 2.1 Neutrals). The default page ground behind white cards. Same value as surface-150.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, nav bar, secondary-button fill. Figma style Surface/100.

tokens.name: surface-150
tokens.usage: Page background. Figma style Surface/150.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Alternate section band (e.g. the footer CTA block). Figma style Surface/200.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Hairline border on sections and the secondary button. Decorative only (1.17:1 on white): never the only thing that marks a control. Figma style Surface/300.

tokens.name: surface-400
tokens.usage: Card and tag border (1px). Decorative only (1.26:1 on white). Figma style Surface/400.

tokens.name: surface-500
tokens.usage: Disabled fills and dividers on surface-300. Figma style Surface/500.

tokens.name: surface-900
tokens.usage: Primary Button fill. Figma style Surface/900.

tokens.name: text-100
tokens.usage: Text on surface-900 and limelight-black (21:1). Figma style Text/100.

tokens.name: text-400
tokens.usage: Muted text: captions, secondary-button label, 'See customer results →'. 4.54:1 on surface-100. SOURCE PAIR FLAG: only 4.38:1 on surface-150 and 4.35:1 on surface-200, so on those grounds use it at 24px+ only, else use text-500. Figma style Text/400.

tokens.name: text-500
tokens.usage: Secondary body text on every surface (6.9:1 on surface-150, 5.7:1 on surface-400). Figma style Text/500.

tokens.name: text-600
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on every surface, accent-blue and all brand gradients (8.6:1 or better). Nav links set it at 80% opacity. Figma style Text/600.

tokens.name: text-button
tokens.usage: Label ink of the agent button in the Figma file (#313131 on surface-100, 13:1). The live site uses text-500 for that label; this system follows the site.

tokens.name: icon-blue
tokens.usage: Ink of the brand line icons (glyph on a glass pedestal). 6.6:1 on surface-100, so it also passes as a 16px icon on every light surface.

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: The main flat accent: highlights, selected chips, small fills. accent-purple, accent-pink and accent-orange are smaller agent-linked highlights. Put text-600 on it (10.9:1), never white. Figma style Accent/Blue.

tokens.name: status-live
tokens.usage: Online/live dot beside an agent name. A mark, never text (2.2:1 on white), and always paired with a word such as 'Live'. Figma style Colors/Green.

tokens.name: accent-purple
tokens.usage: Secondary flat accent from the site (Webflow accent--purple). Small highlights next to Elliot content. Put text-600 on it.

tokens.name: accent-pink
tokens.usage: Secondary flat accent from the site (Webflow accent--pink). The soft glow strokes inside agent tags; small highlights next to Ivy content.

tokens.name: accent-orange
tokens.usage: Secondary flat accent from the site (Webflow orange). Small warm highlights next to Lana content.

tokens.name: glow-peach
tokens.usage: The small dot that sits on the hero highlight pill, and the warm core of the brand glow (Figma Ellipse 12).

tokens.name: limelight-blue
tokens.usage: End stop of gradient-limelight: the brand's signature blue. Glows and large fields only, text-600 on it (8.7:1).

tokens.name: limelight-blue-mid
tokens.usage: Middle stop of gradient-limelight.

tokens.name: ivy-pink
tokens.usage: Middle stop of gradient-ivy. Ivy (Influencer Manager) only.

tokens.name: ivy-blue
tokens.usage: End stop of gradient-ivy.

tokens.name: cooper-aqua
tokens.usage: Middle stop of gradient-cooper. Cooper (Customer Advocacy Manager) only.

tokens.name: cooper-blue
tokens.usage: End stop of gradient-cooper.

tokens.name: lana-pink
tokens.usage: Middle stop of gradient-lana. Lana (Social Intelligence Manager) only.

tokens.name: lana-peach
tokens.usage: End stop of gradient-lana.

tokens.name: elliot-periwinkle
tokens.usage: Middle stop of gradient-elliot. Elliot (Employee Social Manager) only.

tokens.name: elliot-blue
tokens.usage: End stop of gradient-elliot.

gradient.note: Guide 2.1: Primary = Limelight Gradient (trustworthy, calm); Secondary = one gradient per agent (calm, futuristic). All run top to bottom from white. Ring gradients are the 2px frame of the agent button. The site draws the ring as radial-gradient(circle, a, b 40%, c); the ring tokens keep the Figma ellipse, which looks the same on a 36px button.

tokens.name: gradient-limelight
tokens.usage: Primary brand gradient: hero grounds, the logo's 'blue' backdrop, company-level (not agent) moments.

tokens.name: gradient-ivy
tokens.usage: Ivy's page and card grounds.

tokens.name: gradient-cooper
tokens.usage: Cooper's page and card grounds.

tokens.name: gradient-lana
tokens.usage: Lana's page and card grounds.

tokens.name: gradient-elliot
tokens.usage: Elliot's page and card grounds.

tokens.name: gradient-glow
tokens.usage: The soft radial glow of guide 1.1 (calm futurism). Behind agent orbs and on image panels.

tokens.name: ring-limelight
tokens.usage: Agent-button ring for 'Meet AI employees' (company level).

tokens.name: ring-ivy
tokens.usage: Agent-button ring for Ivy.

tokens.name: ring-cooper
tokens.usage: Agent-button ring for Cooper.

tokens.name: ring-lana
tokens.usage: Agent-button ring for Lana.

tokens.name: ring-elliot
tokens.usage: Agent-button ring for Elliot.

tokens.name: border-ivy
tokens.usage: 2px frame of Ivy's pricing card and the 'What each agent does' ribbon (site .ivy-grad).

tokens.name: border-cooper
tokens.usage: 2px frame of Cooper's pricing card (site .pricing-card-grad.is-cooper).

tokens.name: border-elliot
tokens.usage: 2px frame of Elliot's pricing card (site .pricing-card-grad.is-elliot).

styles.name: heading-display
styles.usage: Hero headline on every site page (site .heading-display). Two tones: text-400 lead-in, text-600 for the phrase that matters. Mobile (479px and less): 32px.
styles.sample: Run creator, advocacy, and social programs without adding headcount.

styles.name: heading-xxl
styles.usage: Page hero title. Figma Headings/XXL (H1). Mobile (479px and less): 32px.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.usage: Section title. Figma Headings/XL (H2). Mobile (479px and less): 28px. The site's h2 tracks at -0.8px (-0.02em); the Figma style says -3%.

styles.name: heading-l
styles.usage: Sub-section title. Figma Headings/L (H3). Mobile (479px and less): 26px.

styles.name: heading-m
styles.usage: Card group title. Figma Headings/M. Mobile (479px and less): 24px.

styles.name: heading-s
styles.usage: Card title. Figma Headings/S (H5). Mobile (479px and less): 20px.

styles.name: heading-xs
styles.usage: Small title, list header. Figma Headings/XS (H6). Mobile (479px and less): 18px.

styles.name: body-l
styles.usage: Lead paragraph and card copy. Figma Body/L.

styles.name: body-m
styles.usage: Default body text, nav links. Figma Body/M. Mobile: 12px.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Captions, fine print. Figma Body/S. Mobile: 10px.

styles.name: label-m
styles.usage: Section tags (UPPERCASE), chips, table headers. Figma Label/M, site label--m. Mobile: 12px.

styles.name: label-s
styles.usage: Agent name tags, footer legal links (UPPERCASE). Figma Label/S. Mobile: 10px.

styles.name: label-mono
styles.usage: Code-like agent labels such as { Ivy }. Figma doc 'Label/ M' (Geist Mono Medium).

styles.name: cta-primary
styles.usage: Label of the primary Button. Geist SemiBold 600: Figma CTA/Primary and the live site agree.

styles.name: cta-secondary
styles.usage: Label of the secondary and agent buttons. Figma CTA/Secondary.

spacing.note: Measured from the final Landing, Agent and Pricing pages (auto-layout gaps and paddings).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, nav-link vertical padding, gap between nav links.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; nav-link horizontal padding; secondary-button inner gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter (site section--padding-horizontal on phones); gap inside compact rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; card inner padding; gradient-swatch padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked text blocks in a card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a row.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading and its content; card top padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Standard section padding (site section--padding-vertical and gap, 2.5rem); page gutter.

tokens.name: space-15
tokens.usage: Gap between large content groups.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Large section padding and gap (site ...-large, 5rem); page side margin at 1440.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Gap between major page sections.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Hero top padding under the nav.

tokens.name: radius-xxs
tokens.usage: Hover state of every button: corners sharpen from radius-md to radius-xxs over 0.2s (site .button:hover).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Pricing cards, nav links, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The inner white face of the agent button (outer radius-md minus the 2px ring).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards: the default corner.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large media panels and product screenshots.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Rounded hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Section tags, agent tags ({ Ivy }), the hero highlight pill and avatar orbs (site uses 2rem, 32px).

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Resting cards and buttons on surface-150 (most used shadow in the file).

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, dropdowns, floating nav.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Product screenshots and raised agent cards.

tokens.name: shadow-tag
tokens.usage: Section tag (the bracketed eyebrow) on surface-200.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Cards, gradient swatches, tags (surface-400).

tokens.name: border-section
tokens.usage: Section panels and the secondary button (surface-300).

tokens.name: border-ring
tokens.usage: Outline around the agent button's gradient ring.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control, 2px offset, 17:1 or better on every surface. The site sets focus to accent-blue (#add1ff), which is only 1.5:1 on white, so this system keeps a dark ring.

tokens.name: border-glass
tokens.usage: Floating nav bar and translucent panels (site .nav_container).

tokens.name: border-card
tokens.usage: Problem and value cards laid edge to edge in a row (site .problem-card).

tokens.name: border-dashed
tokens.usage: Left rule of feature cards and the dashed outline of the hero highlight pill.

layout.note: Page widths from the site's Webflow variables.

tokens.name: width-page
tokens.usage: Max width of full-bleed sections (site max-width 98rem).

tokens.name: width-nav
tokens.usage: Max width of the floating nav bar (87.8rem).

tokens.name: width-content
tokens.usage: Content column at 1440 (80px side margins).

tokens.name: width-medium
tokens.usage: Centered text blocks and pricing (container-medium, 64rem).

tokens.name: width-small
tokens.usage: Narrow centered copy (container-small, 48rem).

tokens.name: breakpoint-tablet
tokens.usage: Tablet layout below this width.

tokens.name: breakpoint-mobile
tokens.usage: Mobile landscape below this width.

tokens.name: breakpoint-small
tokens.usage: Mobile portrait: the smaller type scale starts here.
